dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: This realm offers pleasing scenery, a state of quietude, and excellent amenities. Very suitable for those who wish to study the art of mechanics in peace.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Were you perchance inspired by one's own abode?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: It brims with adeptal energy, the views are expansive... Yes, it is most to one's liking.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Speaking of adeptal energy... mortals cannot wield the power of Sub-Space Creation with which this abode was made. Whence did you procure this treasure?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It was a gift from Madame Ping.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Ah, I see.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Streetward Rambler has always been fond of natural scenery, and often laments its transient nature, for the most pleasant sights tend to disappear with the change of seasons...

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Small wonder, then, that she utilized the power of Sub-Space Creation to preserve her favorite sights within this teapot.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Yet it is you, through your furnishing endeavors, who have transformed this sub-space into the most homely of lodgings.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: The next time one feels reticent to seek sustenance in the outdoors... perhaps one shall invite oneself over for dinner.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Oh? You accept the idea with such alacrity...

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Then it is settled. One looks forward to your cooking.

choices.text: I'm not always in the mood to cook...

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Well then, since one presumed to issue one's own invitation, you may leave the cooking to one's new and improved Supreme Cuisine Machine.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: We can eat anything that you desire. Whatever your imagination can conjure, one's machine can surely cook.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Oh? Most appealing. One does have a formidable aptitude for conversation.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: However, one is currently preoccupied with a technical conundrum of great importance... We may need to postpone any idle colloquy for later.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What sort of technical conundrum is this?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: One once developed a supreme housekeeping machine to perform domestic chores such as sweeping and tidying.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: To enhance its functionality, one added a sound response module so that it could be operated with voice commands.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: However, the module is flawed. For instance, if one is too far away from the machine, it cannot detect the audio signal, and thus cannot be remotely operated...

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: ...Do you have any suggestions on how to resolve this problem?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just yell a little louder?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Hmm... A viable solution, technically speaking, although a little inelegant.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: However... yes... Your suggestion has pointed one towards yet another solution. One simply needs to fashion... a sound amplification machine.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: With just a little adeptal energy, such a device could amplify sounds from hundreds of miles away, then pass the relevant commands to other audio-activated mechanisms... One shall have full command over one's contraptions without the need to move a muscle. Glorious!

choices.text: Adeptal energy makes everything so much easier...

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: ...Very well, we may consider this conundrum resolved. Now, back to our conversation.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: When you said that you wanted to have a "chat," did you mean that you would like for one to tell you a story?

choices.text: Yup! I'll make us some tea.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Oh, you are a good child. Yes, with some fine tea to soothe the throat, one shall be able to talk far more fluidly.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Nevertheless... Ahem, one ought to refrain from sharing certain stories with you until having sought permission from some old friends.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: The girls whom you already know quite well, for instance... *sigh* To utter but a word about their childhoods is to hazard their faces scrunching up as if they had bitten into a sour lemon...

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Truly, one is most at ease when speaking with you. Still... you have spoken little of the things you and Paimon have experience in the past.

choices.text: Uhh, I just remembered that I've got something to do...

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Hmph... The ruse is quite unnecessary. If there are things you do not wish to speak of, so be it — one shall enquire no further.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Go. We may pick up this conversation again when you feel more comfortable telling your story. Whatever you share, one vows to never tell a soul.

choices.text: Wait here a sec, I'll go get that tea!
Yup! I'm sure you have some cool stories.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: No, not "some"... All of one's stories should qualify as "cool."

choices.text: Is there any problem that mechanics can't solve?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you want to do?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: No, in fact, nothing in particular... Mortals are wont to rush from one endeavor to the next, but this is because their lifespan is short. They fear being left behind by their peers if they waste but a little of the time they have.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: One... has never felt that kind of distress.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: By nature, adepti are not part of the human world. For us, centuries can pass by in a flash. Not to mention that one prefers to focus single mindedly on the study of mechanisms, and tends to not to be distracted by worldly attachments.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Except, perhaps... Hmm, yes... The exception would be one's disciples... One cares for them as if they were one's own children.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then, uh... Why don't we just... chill out and relax?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Hehe... Now that is another of one's areas of expertise.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Very well. In that case, allow one to share with you some rather novel means of relaxation.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You mean... there's an art to it?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: There is indeed. One has quite the compilation of methods right here. Behold:

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: "Play mahjong with strangers," "Go to Mt. Hulao to knock on some amber"... Whenever one feels in need of relaxation, one simply draws at random from this collection.

choices.text: Sounds like an odd lottery you have going there...

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: And what, pray tell, is wrong with a little oddity in service of relaxation and fun?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: And of course, if you have other suggestions on novel ways to relax, one is all ears.

choices.text: For today... I just want to zone out.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Hmm, there is certainly merit to simply letting the mind wander freely. In idleness, we often find sparks of inspiration that might otherwise go unnoticed.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Still, one is at something of a loss regarding where to best partake in such an activity within this teapot...

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: You can change the scenery here at will to suit your mood, correct? Then perhaps... could you craft a likeness of Jueyun Karst?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: ...No, on second thought, save yourself the trouble. Let us pay a visit to the real Jueyun Karst. Would you care to soar the skies by one's side? One could easily make that happen with one's mastery over wind and cloud.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sounds good to me.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Then it is decided. One needs just a moment to make a plan and retrieve a mechanism or two, and then we shall be on our way!

choices.text: For today... I just want to not think about anything.
I've already done quite a few of these things.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Oh? Would you care to share your thoughts on the experience? One is quite curious.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Xianyun.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Good morning. I see you are a fellow early riser.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Is this because a hero's work never ends? Or are you simply hungry for breakfast? In either case, be sure to wrap up warm. We don't want you catching a cold.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Xianyun.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Good night. The tranquility here in the hours after dark provides an ideal opportunity to focus on mechanical studies.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: You also have an interest in mechanics? Well then, do you wish to be one's assistant for the evening?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Oh? What a quiet and tranquil spot, and it's modeled after a human village...

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: A perfect place to sit and meditate...

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: How did you... Hmph, clearly you somehow found out that one has been tinkering away with one's mechanisms and getting no sleep during the nights...

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: You brought me all the way out here just to show me the food stalls? Well, this was most unnecessary. These recipes look quite elementary — one could just as easily make them in the comfort of one's own home.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Hmm? Oh my, that wonderful aroma...

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Ahem... Well, since we're already here, we might as well take a seat and order some delicacies!
